title: THE RIOT SCATTERGUN KICKS THE SCREEN
why: His Q5: gun and enemy feel this week. The camera shake only grows when the shot number rises and is 18 px times trauma squared, so the flat 2.2 every light gun set was under half a pixel, and the Riot Scattergun (six pellets, 96 damage a pull) kicked like a pistol. The kick is now per gun, and the scattergun sets 6.5: about 4 px at 1080p, gone in a third of a second. Every other gun keeps its kick.
now: The Riot Scattergun now kicks the screen when it fires.

edits.replacement: G.shake=Math.max(G.shake,gunShake(wep));   // v28.xx (cw-kickshotgun): the kick is per gun (GUN_SHAKE), the Riot Scattergun 6.5
